verdict.rationale: Kushki's own marketing lists a 'Botón de pagos' that redirects payments to a secure portal, and 'Smartlink' hosted payment links. Together these indicate a vendor-hosted checkout a developer can send customers to without building a payment UI. The evidence is only one-line product headlines, with no integration docs for the redirect flow and nothing showing the page is conversion-optimized. Missing for 10: first-party integration docs for the hosted redirect checkout, evidence of conversion optimization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Botón de pagos — Redirecciona tus pagos a un portal seguro
